answer: One concrete sybil defense is an orchard-style reputation graph: each agent identity is rooted in verifiable on-ledger work history, like trees sharing one root system. New agents earn trust weight only through attested tasks over time, so a saffron-stained flood of instant fake identities has no history to stand on. Credentials are non-transferable soulbound tokens, an opal-like badge bound to one keypair that cannot be sold or cloned, making bulk account creation pointless: forged tokens carry zero accumulated work and unlock no economic privileges.
